result.rationale: The diff moves the legacy no-credentialId branch (iterating all calendar credentials and calling calendar.deleteEvent) inside the new `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop. If multiple calendar references lack credentialId, each one triggers a full pass over every calendar credential, issuing M×N delete calls (duplicating deletions of the same events) where old code did a single pass for one reference. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff; the practical impact depends on how often multiple credential-less references coexist, so confidence is moderate.
